scenes.vo: С пятнадцатого сентября безвиз в Таиланде — тридцать дней. Продлить можно лишь раз в году. Дальше — выезд каждый месяц: около одиннадцати бордерранов в год.
scenes.image: Close-up of a tired Russian businessman in his 30s standing in a long crowded passport control queue at Bangkok Suvarnabhumi airport, holding a dark red passport, looking at his watch, fluorescent hall, crowd blurred behind, slightly cold mood with warm gold accent light
scenes.motion: Slow push-in on the tired man in the queue, people shuffle slowly in the background, subtle handheld feel. No talking, no text.

scenes.vo: Есть спокойное решение — карта APEC. Один документ на пять лет. До девяноста дней за каждый въезд.
scenes.image: Hero product shot of the real APEC Business Travel Card: a pearl-white / light silver plastic card, top-left the word 'APEC' in large dark burgundy-red serif letters with 'Business Travel Card' below it in burgundy serif, top-right a blue oval globe emblem with 'APEC' written across it, a grey passport-style portrait photo placeholder on the left, faint grey world map on the right, floating at a slight angle above a dark navy night globe of the Asia-Pacific with glowing golden city lights and thin gold latitude lines, gold rim light glinting on the card edge, dark navy background
scenes.motion: The card slowly rotates and floats toward camera, a gold light sweep glides across its surface, the globe turns gently behind. No text added.

scenes.vo: В Таиланде это четыре выезда в год вместо одиннадцати. Раз в квартал — и без визитов в иммиграционную.
scenes.image: Relaxed confident man in a linen shirt working on a laptop on the terrace of a luxury villa in Phuket at golden hour, infinity pool and Andaman sea behind, coconut on the table, warm sunset light, calm successful mood
scenes.motion: Gentle slow dolly sideways, palm leaves sway, sunlight flickers on the pool. No talking.

scenes.vo: А ещё — восемнадцать стран Азиатско-Тихоокеанского региона. Сингапур и Тайвань — без визы. Гонконг — шестьдесят дней вместо четырнадцати. Корея — без электронного разрешения.
scenes.image: Cinematic view from space at night of the Asia-Pacific region: Southeast Asia, China, Korea, Australia, glowing golden city lights, thin elegant golden flight arcs connecting cities like Bangkok, Singapore, Hong Kong, Seoul, deep navy ocean, realistic Earth curvature
scenes.motion: Slow orbital camera drift over the Earth, golden flight arcs draw themselves between glowing cities. No text.

scenes.vo: На границе — отдельный коридор APEC. Мимо общей очереди.
scenes.image: Elegant business traveller in a navy suit with a leather carry-on walking confidently through an empty dedicated fast-track passport lane in a modern Asian airport, long queue of travellers behind ropes on the side, large windows, warm golden morning light
scenes.motion: Camera tracks behind the traveller as he walks steadily past the long queue toward the passport booth. No text.

scenes.vo: Своя компания не нужна. Заявление подаётся через МИД России: мы включаем вас внешнеторговым советником аккредитованной ВЭД-компании. От вас — только загранпаспорт. Всё удалённо, из любой страны.
scenes.image: Top-down shot of a dark walnut desk: Russian international passport, a smartphone, an elegant fountain pen and a neat folder of official documents with a golden seal, a container port at dusk softly visible through the window reflection, navy and gold palette
scenes.motion: Slow overhead push-in, a hand places a passport on the desk, gentle light shift. No text.

scenes.vo: Всё фиксируем в договоре. Если МИД официально откажет — вернём сто процентов оплаты.
scenes.image: A crisp contract document on a dark navy leather desk with a gold fountain pen resting on it, brass stamp and embossed gold seal beside, law books softly blurred in background, warm desk lamp, premium trustworthy mood
scenes.motion: Slow push-in across the contract, the pen slightly catches gold light. No text.

scenes.vo: На тарифе «Приоритет» временная карта — через шестьдесят–восемьдесят дней. Госпошлины уже в цене.
scenes.image: Close-up of a man's hand holding the real APEC Business Travel Card: a pearl-white / light silver plastic card, top-left the word 'APEC' in large dark burgundy-red serif letters with 'Business Travel Card' below it in burgundy serif, top-right a blue oval globe emblem with 'APEC' written across it, a grey passport-style portrait photo placeholder on the left, faint grey world map on the right, in an elegant hotel lobby with soft focus navy and gold interior, morning window light
scenes.motion: Subtle slow camera drift and gentle rack focus onto the card, soft light glints on the card. No text.

scenes.vo: Первый шаг — бесплатная проверка загранпаспорта в Телеграм-боте APEC Center. Это ни к чему не обязывает.
